targets.review_note: Process contiguous power-of-two team blocks. After each complete bracket round, each block retains exactly one undefeated upper-bracket team and one lower-bracket survivor; sorted team-number pairing keeps all matches within the next doubled block. A four-state DP records whether these two survivors are favorites. A base pair contributes its single upper match and both possible winner/loser assignments. Merging two blocks adds their upper match, their first lower match, then the second lower match between the upper loser and lower winner. Enumerate both winners of each match and count a match once iff at least one participant is favorite. Retain the best score for each outgoing two-bit state. Finally add the single grand-final match. Team identity no longer matters inside a fixed block because every remaining cross-block pairing follows the same interval order.
